# Retro Booth

> Retro Booth sells classic-looking commercial photo booths with modern technology inside, for Australian venues to own. Customers buy the booth outright or with finance, and every booth runs on an ongoing software and support subscription. Retro Booth is not a hire company and does not sell event packages. Function centres, wedding venues and wineries include the booth in their own packages.

Contact: hello@retrobooth.com.au · 03 8899 8999 (Australia)

## Booths

- [Standing Booth](https://retrobooth.com.au/#booths): the classic upright cabinet with curtain, for foyers, bars and function spaces. Instant prints and digital copies, branded cabinet and signage, guests pay at the booth.
- [Open Style Booth](https://retrobooth.com.au/booths/open-style/): designed for small rooms, so a spare room or corner can become a photo booth. Instant prints and digital copies, guests pay at the booth.
- [Sitting Booth](https://retrobooth.com.au/#booths): the traditional sit-down booth with a bench seat for groups. Same prints, digital copies and branding options.

## Key facts

- Ownership: the venue owns the booth, in its venue and under its brand, bought outright or with finance subject to eligibility.
- Ongoing cost: a software and support subscription. Retro Booth explains what is included when preparing a quote.
- Pricing: depends on model, finish and customisation. No public prices are published; request a tailored quote.
- Customisation: exterior finishes, venue branding, sponsor wraps, photo strip designs and digital experience, subject to availability.
- Staffing: guests operate the booth themselves.
- Guest data: optional; marketing use requires guest consent.
- Audience: pubs, bars and hotels; nightclubs and entertainment venues; shopping centres and retail; function centres, wedding venues and wineries that sell the booth in their own packages; people starting a photo booth business.
